title: Construct Binary Tree From Preorder And Inorder Traversal
prompt: Given two integer arrays preorder and inorder where preorder is the preorder traversal of a binary tree and inorder is the inorder traversal of the same tree, construct and return the binary tree.
hints: Preorder: root first, then left subtree, then right. Inorder: left, root, right.
First element of preorder is the root. Find root in inorder - everything left is left subtree, everything right is right subtree.
Recursively build: root = preorder[0], find index in inorder. Left = buildTree(preorder[1..mid], inorder[0..mid-1]), right = buildTree(preorder[mid+1..], inorder[mid+1..]).
Use a map for inorder value -> index for O(1) lookup. O(n) time.
